text: Every New Year's Eve, the monster Nian came down from the mountains.
asr: Every New Year's Eve, the monster Nion came down from the mountains.

text: One by one, the village put out its lights.
But Nian fears three things: the color red, bright light, and loud noise.
asr: But Nyan fears three things, the color red, bright light, and loud noise.

text: Crackle, bang! And away ran Nian.
asr: crackle bang, and away ran Nyan.

text: That is why, every New Year, we still paste red paper on our windows.
